desc.zh: 在棋盘路径中共享前缀，理解字典树与回溯。
desc.en: Share board-path prefixes with a trie and reversible backtracking.

complexity: O(S + B·4·3^(L-1)) time; O(S + L) auxiliary space, plus O(W) output references

concepts.name: Trie prefix pruning
concepts.description: Share prefixes while preserving terminal markers and child branches.

concepts.name: Board backtracking invariant
concepts.description: A numbered simple path matches the current trie prefix; undo restores it.
